description: Control the Seeed Studio reBot Arm B601: 6-DoF Damiao (B601-DM) or RobStride (B601-RS) arm with per-variant kinematics, collision geometry and 3D models, motion-service support, and the parallel gripper on either variant (force capping and hold detection are DM only).

models.short_description: B601 parallel gripper (DM and RS) with one-DoF frame kinematics
Finds attached B601 USB-CAN boards by USB id and proposes arm + gripper configs
